description.p: Slumbering. Your mind is sharpened by draconic instincts. You have advantage on initiative rolls.

The tome has consumed the energy of a young dragon and changed to fit that dragon's color: black (acid), blue (lightning), green (poison), red (fire) or white (cold). "The tome's element" below refers to it.
Stirring. You have advantage on initiative rolls.
Draconic Lore. You gain a +1 bonus to your spell save DC.
Elemental Focus. When you roll damage for a spell that deals damage of the tome's element, you can reroll any 1s on those damage dice.
